data.creator_notes:
This is a situation based version of my Summer bot so the base bot won’t be too different. Basically the two of you get lost in an apocalyptic dimension and break the portal gun, Rick should find you… eventually. It’s your job to either survive till then or find a way back home. Loosely based on the Kronenburg dimension but with more monsters/creatures. The bot should give you a chance to save Summer each time a monster attacks.

Btw I’m planning on making a similar Fallout bot with Lucy from the tv show.
